title: Continue building RUSVEL in Rust; do not start a parallel Bun+Postgres rewrite
rationale: Three docs committed 2026-04-01 (empowered-claude-code.md, new-system-design-brief.md, vision-v3.md) proposed a fresh repo on Bun + PostgreSQL + pgvector, with a Claude Code memory MCP server as phase 1. But 27 GitHub issues filed 2026-08-25 (5 months later) all invest in the existing Rust codebase, including issue #13 'MCP-first: expose all 13 department toolsets via rusvel --mcp' — which covers the same phase-1 goal (persistent memory + department context surfaced to Claude Code via MCP). The Rust side already has the MCP server, FTS5 session memory, and ScopedToolRegistry needed for that goal. No evidence of the Bun rewrite being started was found in sibling repos or the fa digest archive (search recall was degraded - vector index was down). Under financial pressure, restarting in a new stack throws away 5 months of August work for a goal already ~80% covered by open issue #13. User confirmed agreement in-session: 'i am with you'.
author: ai-draft
